Market note

Selling an online business in Nordic countries

Four small markets with high digital maturity, where successful businesses usually serve more than one country from the outset.

Channels

Search and direct traffic dominate more than marketplaces in several categories. English language operations are common, which widens the group of potential buyers.

Structures

Share transactions are the norm. Currency exposure appears in any operation that buys in euros and sells in local currencies, and buyers price it.

Buyers

Regional operators, plus buyers from the rest of Europe attracted by businesses that already run in English and can be managed remotely.

Practical

Multi-country operations need a clean split of results per country in the file. Without it, a buyer cannot judge which market is carrying the business.

Listings

Businesses currently offered across Europe are published at the European marketplace (https://www.businessforsale.eu/online-business-for-sale).
